title: I Did 30 Days of Cold Outreach. Here's What Actually Worked.
script: I did 30 days of cold outreach — cold emails, LinkedIn messages, DMs — and tracked every single response. Most people do not show the real numbers. Here they are. Day 3 to 7: I sent the template that every guru recommends. Generic intro, value prop, call to action. Response rate: 4%. Disappointing. Day 14: I made one change. I stopped pitching and started asking a question. 'Quick question about your content strategy' instead of 'I can help your business.' Response rate jumped to 18%. Doubled. Day 20: I stopped sending attachments. Plain text only. Suddenly people replied. Nobody wants to download your PDF. Day 30 final numbers: 90 messages sent, 14 responses, 3 qualified leads, 1 actual opportunity. Cold outreach works, but not the way you're doing it. The template that got the most replies: two sentence intro, one specific observation about them, one question. Plain text. No attachments. Subject line: quick question about their specific work. That is it.
